description: Create an SVG placeholder profile icon. Use for synthetic avatars in demos and UI prototypes. Returns SVG markup, not a photorealistic likeness.

pattern.description: Avatar layout: initials, blocks, circles or random.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for repeatable test fixtures; do not use as a secret.

size.description: SVG width and height in pixels, from 32 to 256.

text.description: Optional initials or label used to customize the placeholder.

name: generate-avatar
title: Generate an SVG placeholder avatar
